author: Joe Mullin
description: Following criticism, lawmakers have narrowed the GUARD Act, a bill aimed at restricting minors’ access to certain AI systems. The earlier version could have applied broadly to nearly every AI-powered chatbot or search tool. The amended bill focuses more narrowly on so-called “AI companions”—conversational systems designed to simulate emotional or interpersonal interactions with users.  That change does address […]
title: Congress Narrowed The GUARD Act, But Serious Problems Remain

author: Mike Masnick
description: Earlier this week, OpenAI became the latest tech company to publicly endorse KOSA, the Kids Online Safety Act. The company, conveniently, tries to frame this as being about its support of child safety. It’s not. It’s about political horse trading, desperation for good publicity, and building a regulatory moat. KOSA would help create stronger online […]
title: OpenAI’s KOSA Endorsement Is Regulatory Capture With A Smiley Face

author: Tim Cushing

author: Karl Bode
description: A new “Christian” mobile phone provider named Radiant Mobile is promising to offer a wireless service that censors all LGBTQ+ content. title: ‘Christian’ Wireless Provider Promises To Censor All LGBTQ Content
